title: VYBE 0.12.1
notes:
PLAYBACK & QUEUE
• Online retries now preserve the full autoplay queue.
• Recoverable source refreshes no longer show a false error.
• Artist-related continuation prevents single-song loops.

DISCOVERY
• New Finds is now first on Home.
• Search opens instantly from cache with one loading indicator.

LIBRARY & ACCOUNT
• Internal cache is a strict unique last 10 and its Library folder is removed.
• Album lookup and YouTube artist metadata are more reliable.
• Daily 8:00 AM backup, last-backup time, and account avatar added.
